timing_scope: Nonstream end-to-end request and wave timing, including queueing, prefill and generation; not TTFT or steady-state decode.
strict_definition: Reported exact comparisons of text, returned token entries, all reported generated/top logprobs and finish reason; no tolerance or text-only substitution.
diagnostic_scope: Generated-token logprobs are compared only on the identical generated prefix. First-position top-5 diagnostics compare only entries common to both returned top_logprobs dictionaries (request logprobs=5), not a full-vocabulary distribution.
cache_accounting: cold/fresh require zero cached tokens; hit/repeat require positive reuse

monitoring.scope: Per-job samples include startup; non-200 samples do not alone establish an outage after readiness.
